category_spanning_reviewers: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews r1 WHERE r1.user_id IN (SELECT r2.user_id FROM reviews r2 WHERE r2.category != r1.category) AND r1.category = 'office products'
office_product_reviewers: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM reviews WHERE category = 'office products'
category_count_per_user: SELECT r.user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.category) AS category_count FROM reviews r WHERE r.category = 'office products' GROUP BY r.user_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.category) >= 2
